title: Bones on religion: humans and aliens part of the same creation

tellings.quote: he mentioned that the that we are part of the same creation.

plain: Between 1990 and 1993, at a place he calls Base 2, a former Air Force sergeant named Dan Sherman says a figure he calls Bones told him that humans and aliens "are part of the same creation." Sherman tells Michels this as something said to him directly, during work he says the NSA had him do communicating with aliens. If true, it would mean the beings themselves describe a shared religious origin with us.
